collection.description: A rope swing tied to a sturdy tree delights the children but worries several caregivers.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A rope swing tied to a sturdy tree delights the children but worries several caregivers.

choices.label: Ask Children to Design Safe Rules

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A frayed knot is replaced before anyone is hurt.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The children become proud safety inspectors and begin checking every knot.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The smaller children get their own gentle turns.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child), an older child, resents being told to slow down but later helps a younger one.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: More children can use it independently.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The daring older children miss the height and propose a separate challenge.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Their first rule is simply "no pushing," which everyone understands.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They argue over fairness until (elder) helps them test their ideas.
